content.comment_body: Good morning everyone, Is there a way to retrieve the IP address and show it on the [product_name] screen? ([article_no]) Thank you in advance. [user_name]

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. If you mean displaying it in a message text: that's not possible. However, within the [product_name] menu, you can go to Network > IP address and view or change the IP address there if you have admin access.
My goal was to display the IP address within a text message. It's unfortunate this isn't supported, but thank you for clarifying. [user_name]
The only way to have the IP address in a message text is to enter it manually. Automatically reading the IP address in the [product_name] program is not possible.
That's what I've already done, but I was hoping for an automatic solution. Thanks again.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum users want an automated way to display the current IP address of the [product_name] on-screen in their messages, rather than accessing it manually through menus. The existing product does not support automatic IP retrieval, requiring users to enter it manually, which is inconvenient and doesn't update dynamically.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish for a feature that allows the current IP address to be automatically read and shown in a message, without having to manually input data or navigate through menus.
